text_block_list.text:
It was rehearsal day for the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai. 
I arrived at the practice grounds 
accompanied by 
Daiwa Scarlet and Aston Machan, who came 
to observe.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so many interesting spots. 
Thank you very much for bringing me along!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're very welcome. 
After all, I owed you one, Machan.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, kind of. 
Still, are you really sure just watching 
practice is enough? 
You could have asked for anything else.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No, this is wonderful. This is where I 
wanted to be. 
While I cheer on Scarlet, 
please take some promotional photos of 
Machan, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —Hah!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, another bullseye. 
The arrow was sucked right into the 
target.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Scarlet has been truly amazing lately. 
Entrusted as leader of such an important 
festival, 
and drawing all the spotlight at the Fan 
Thanksgiving Festival.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
As an ultra-super-mascot, 
I can't afford to fall behind—*cough*.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
*cough*, *cough*... 
...Mmh.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Are you alright? 
Machan, you always tend to fall ill in 
spring, so please don't push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, spring and I are on terrible terms 
once again this year. 
How frustrating... *cough*, *cough*.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—I know! 
My yabusame will banish it for you!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Peace under heaven, abundant harvests, 
health for all, and healing of sickness. 
Yabusame is a sacred ritual to ward off 
misfortune and deliver our prayers.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Whatever poor health or ailments you've 
got, I'll blow them all away!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—...Oh, really! 
I will look forward to the main event, 
then.

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor A
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, my, hehe. How nostalgic.

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, I just happened to overhear 
your lovely conversation. 
It's about time for a break. 
Would you care for some tea?

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
...What you just said, Scarlet-san, 
reminded me of an old story my 
great-grandmother used to tell.

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
My great-grandmother was frail from a 
young age, 
and people said she wouldn't live to see 
adulthood.

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
With each passing year her illness 
worsened, 
and just when everyone braced for the 
worst... 
her childhood friend, a horsegirl, was 
chosen as Divine Steed.

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
"I will never let the flame of your life 
go out." 
Fired with that prayer, her arrow struck 
dead center, 
and was then presented to my bedridden 
great-grandmother.

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
And then... as if by a miracle, 
my great-grandmother began to recover 
completely.

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
—Hearing that story inspired me 
to want to take part in yabusame myself, 
you see.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wow... Is that so! 
What a wonderful reason.

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor B
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty much the same way. 
Watching my old man and grandpa do it, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor B
text_block_list.text:
Giving everything to support the Divine 
Steed and fire up the festival— 
I just thought it was the coolest thing 
ever.

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor C
text_block_list.text:
I watched yabusame as a tourist once, 
and I was completely captivated. 
I ended up packing up and moving here on 
pure impulse!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hearing that makes me realize all over 
again. 
Yabusame is a sacred ritual that holds 
deep, personal meaning 
for all of those people too, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I used to worry whether performing 
yabusame at the Goshiki Shuntaisai 
actually had any meaning, but... 
I didn't even need to second-guess it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I want to make this yabusame a success, 
together with every single one of them...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Do your best, Scarlet. 
Machan will cheer you on in her official 
capacity as mascot.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —Taaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructors
text_block_list.text:
"Wonderful! Keep that up!" 
"Yes, yes! Your form is getting better and 
better!" 
"Give it your all~!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It feels so warm. 
Everyone is looking at Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Because there are people capturing her 
through their lens, 
she will remain in their memories. 
...Scarlet is truly loved, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, aren't you exaggerating just a 
little? 
...Still, 
I can definitely feel their feelings—right 
here in my chest.
